info.name: Kosply API
info.description: Kosply backend — marketplace second-hand mahasiswa. Run against http://localhost:3000 (npm start) with Postgres up + seeded (`npm run seed` in lib/db). Flow: Auth/Register (or Login) first — the token is captured automatically.

request.description: Root probe. Returns `{ name, status, env }`.
Service health (uptime, timestamp).
Register a buyer (201). Captures token + userId.
Email + password login (200). Refreshes token + userId.
Request a 4-digit OTP. Always 200 (no enumeration). Copy devCode outside production.
Set a new password with the OTP (paste devCode into resetCode first).
Public catalog (q, limit).

request.description: Submit KTM application (JWT). One active application per user.
Own application status (JWT).
ADMIN only; buyers get 403.
APPROVE promotes to SELLER; REJECT needs rejectionReason. Replace :id. ADMIN only.
Open/reuse a COD room (productId derives the seller). Captures conversationId.
Own rooms, newest activity first (JWT).
Room detail, members only.
Send TEXT/IMAGE/LOCATION bubble as a member.
History oldest-first; marks the other side read.
Open a help ticket (KSP-…). Captures ticketId.
Own tickets (JWT).
Detail + messages (internal notes hidden from reporters).
Reply in the ticket (admins may set isInternal).
Owner or ADMIN closes.
Report fraud (RPT-…). Needs a target. Captures reportId.
ADMIN only (?status=PENDING).
WARNING | DELETE_PRODUCT | BAN_USER (NONE dismisses). Replace :id or use {{reportId}}.
Separate admins table. Seed via ADMIN_SEED_EMAIL/PASSWORD then npm run seed (lib/db).
Active AI models for the Flutter selector.
ADMIN only. Captures modelId.
Pricing/name/enable-disable. ADMIN only.
Refused when chat history references it. ADMIN only.
Agent machine API: keyword search.
